description:
Dynamic Windows 11 Theme, Night Light & Multi-Monitor Hardware Brightness Controller

Luminark is a native Windows 11 utility engineered to automatically harmonize your display environment.
It synchronizes Windows system and app themes with day/night schedules or Windows Night Light,
and provides seamless hardware-level multi-monitor brightness control via DDC/CI and WMI.
What's New in Luminark v1.1.0:
- Monitor Video Input Switching (DDC/CI): Switch inputs (HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C) from the mini flyout with safety countdown and instant cancel.
- Hardware Audio Volume & Mute: Adjust monitor speaker volume and mute external displays directly from the flyout.
- Custom Monitor Renaming: Assign custom names to monitors with persistent hardware IDs surviving reconnects and reboots.
- Intelligent Display Auto-Detection: Progressive multi-stage detection pipeline (2s, 4s, 6s) and WM_DEVICECHANGE hardware hook for reliable USB-C / DisplayPort Alt Mode hotplug discovery.
- Global Keyboard Shortcuts: Customizable hotkeys for Dark Mode (Ctrl+Alt+D), Light Mode (Ctrl+Alt+L), and Toggle Theme (Ctrl+Alt+T).
- Windows 11 Integration: Added official Luminark icon in Windows Installed Apps and updated publisher to Silviu Vlasceanu.
- Efficiency: 0.0% idle CPU and ~1-5 MB memory footprint.
